title: Dashboard configuration
description: Companion to the metrics files. Cross-checks (unknown/missing names) are done by validate_metrics.py and serialize_json.py. Paths are node names joined with '.'.

nameOrPath.description: Bare node name (matches anywhere in the hierarchy) or a path.

metadataRef.description: Field of the run's metadata file, '@' followed by the field name ('@pr_title'), nested fields joined with '.' ('@a.b').

labels.description: Flat map of node name (category, metric) or metadata field -> label (string).

units.description: Map of metadata field -> display unit. Metadata values are not converted.

unit_types_file.description: Unit types file (see unit_types.schema.json) mapping metric paths to unit types, relative to this file. The metrics files' 'units' map these unit types to source units.

unit_types.description: Map of unit type -> target unit ('' for unitless). Values of a unit type without an entry are kept in their source units.

summary.description: Paths of the metrics or metadata fields to be presented in the run summaries.

overview.description: Paths of the metrics or metadata fields to be presented on the overview cards.

unplottable.description: Categories or metrics excluded from plotting: a bare name matches the node anywhere in the hierarchy, a path matches that node (and everything below it).
